headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the charge with a 4-hit, 1-home run game, driving in 3 runs. The New York Mets also secured a win, taking down the Kansas City Royals 7-3 behind Sean Manaea's 7.0 innings pitched. The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory behind Ben Rice's pair of home runs and five RBIs. The Chicago Cubs fell short in Baltimore, dropping a 2-3 decision to the Orioles.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Washington Nationals right-handed pitcher Jake Irvin, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. The Cincinnati Reds' Matt McLain has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 8, 2026, with a left calf strain. Other notable injuries include Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies), Brad Lord (Washington Nationals), Owen Caissie (Miami Marlins), John King (Miami Marlins), Tim Herrin (Cleveland Guardians), and Ranger Suarez (Boston Red Sox).

The Detroit Tigers made their first trade of the month, sending RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets in exchange for cash. The Tigers also traded RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, while the Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, behind a strong performance from their offense. Jake Mangum led the charge with a 4-hit, 1-home run game, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Cruise Past Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with a pair of home runs and five RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 2-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles performance. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Trevor Rogers pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' Jake Irvin Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right-handed pitcher Jake Irvin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

top_news.title: **Tigers Make Trade Debut on July 5th**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made their first trade of the month, sending RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets in exchange for cash.
